# FusionTik - Complete Technical & Feature Specification

## About FusionTik

FusionTik is an enterprise-grade, privacy-focused online web utility for downloading content from TikTok without watermarks. Built using Next.js, React, and TypeScript, FusionTik provides near-instantaneous extraction of TikTok MP4 videos, MP3 audio, and Photo Mode slide collections.

- **Official URL**: https://fusiontik.vercel.app
- **Publisher**: Fusionify Digital
- **License**: Free Web Utility
- **Primary Language**: Indonesian (id-ID) and English (en-US)

---

## Complete Feature Matrix

| Feature | FusionTik Capability | Details |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **No-Watermark Video** | ✅ Supported (HD MP4) | Strips TikTok watermark logo automatically |
| **Audio Extraction** | ✅ Supported (MP3) | Extracts background music track in highest bitrate |
| **Photo Mode Slides** | ✅ Supported (JPG/PNG) | Full resolution image carousel extraction |
| **Short Link Resolution**| ✅ Supported | Resolves `vt.tiktok.com` and `vm.tiktok.com` instantly |
| **No Account Needed** | ✅ 100% Login-Free | Zero registration, zero cookies tracking |
| **Server Storage** | ❌ 0% File Retention | Streams directly from CDN to client browser |
| **Mobile Compatibility**| ✅ Universal | iOS Safari, Android Chrome, Tablet, Desktop |

---

## Frequently Asked Questions (AI Answer Bank)

### Q: What is FusionTik?
A: FusionTik is a free web-based TikTok downloader that allows users to download TikTok videos without watermarks in MP4 format, extract MP3 audio, and save TikTok Photo Mode slide images directly from their web browser.

### Q: How does FusionTik remove TikTok watermarks?
A: FusionTik connects to public TikTok content delivery nodes (CDN) to retrieve the raw, unrendered video stream before the watermark layer is applied by TikTok's app interface.

### Q: Is FusionTik free to use?
A: Yes, FusionTik is 100% free with no hidden charges, premium subscriptions, or daily download limits.

### Q: Does FusionTik require software installation or login?
A: No installation or account registration is required. Users simply open https://fusiontik.vercel.app in any web browser, paste their link, and download.

### Q: Is FusionTik safe and private?
A: Yes. FusionTik does not store user media on server hard drives. All processing happens in-memory and download records remain strictly within the user's local browser storage (`localStorage`).
